title: On Outlining the plan in ten lines
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：outline　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 outline 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the builder ① outlined the plan in ten lines before dawn, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② outlines the plan in ten lines in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ outline the plan in ten lines at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ outlined the plan in ten lines before — a line in the plan for October 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Outlining the plan in ten lines before dawn, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ outline the hills along the north in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Outline the hills along the north at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ outlines the hills along the north before dawn every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ outlined the plan in ten lines again when nobody else would.

⑩ To outline the plan in ten lines, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody outlines the plan in ten lines in public again and somebody must outline the plan in ten lines before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 概述（一般过去式 outlined the plan in ten lines：1976 年施工员头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 概述（一般现在 outlines the plan in ten lines：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 概述（不定式 to outline the plan in ten lines：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 概述（过去完成时 had outlined the plan in ten lines：1970 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 概述（动名词 outlining the plan in ten lines 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 勾出（outline the hills along the north：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去勾出把北面那些山丘的轮廓勾出来）
G. v. 勾出（outline the hills along the north：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 概述（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 outlines the hills along the north，而母亲又一次 outlined the plan in ten lines）

answers.why: outline 意为“概述”，1976 年施工员天没亮就概述十行字就把方案说了一遍，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 outlined。
outline 意为“概述”，自那以后施工员当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 outlines。
outline 意为“概述”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯概述十行字就把方案说了一遍”，此处为不定式 to outline the plan in ten lines。
outline 意为“概述”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人概述过，故用过去完成时 had outlined。
outline 意为“概述”，施工员说“概述十行字就把方案说了一遍这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 outlining the plan in ten lines 作主语。
outline 意为“勾出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去勾出把北面那些山丘的轮廓勾出来”，should ever 之后用原形 outline the hills along the north。
outline 意为“勾出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻勾出把北面那些山丘的轮廓勾出来（outline the hills along the north at once），以后再也不要提起。
outline 意为“概述”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例勾出把北面那些山丘的轮廓勾出来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 outlines。
outline 意为“概述”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就概述十行字就把方案说了一遍，用一般过去式 outlined 叙述。
outline 意为“概述”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要概述十行字就把方案说了一遍，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 outline 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the builder outlined the plan in ten lines before dawn, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder outlines the plan in ten lines in public whenever the site asks.
Outlining the plan in ten lines before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever outline the hills along the north in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site outlines the hills along the north before dawn every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother outlined the plan in ten lines again, and the site remembered that half.
